summary: M13 plugin activation no longer hangs when the composition mounts no Settings provider. apply() awaits the live scope only when settingsServicePresent(ctx) is true (new resolveActivationConfig in settings.ts); a headless/CLI composition resolves its schema-validated composition layer immediately and still registers rlm_eval (pre-M13 contract). A CordisError INACTIVE_EFFECT guard prevents a pending continuation from registering after plugin dispose.

pointers: Issue#79 waits and merges user layer

steps: Synchronized local main to origin/main 5a1b6e1 and ran baseline (typecheck PASS, 250 tests: 235 pass/15 skip).
Verified src/index.ts applied an unconditional awaitRlmSettings(ctx) before registerRlmPlugin, so a composition without a Settings provider never activated.

Because node --test cannot import src/index.ts (its .js specifiers are not rewritten by strip-only type loading), the decision logic moved into settings.ts as the testable boundary (resolveActivationConfig) and index.ts became a thin caller.
Regression covers both branches: no provider resolves immediately under a 500ms race, and a mounted provider merges the user layer before registration.
limitations: src/index.ts wiring itself is not directly importable under node --test (ESM .js specifiers); the tested boundary is resolveActivationConfig, which index.ts consumes.
